fixedTitles: FR-RESP-01: ModeChoice screen withheld the entire intro (subject, methodology, deadline) instead of only the question preview, contradicting the spec's literal scenario text and the design doc's own Decision 5 — added intro block (greeting, methodology, deadline) above the confidentiality note and mode buttons

chooseMode returned the same generic 'could not save, try again' message for a non-collecting (done/expired) cycle as for an actual write failure, inviting a pointless retry instead of explaining the cycle is closed — added dedicated respondent.modeChoiceClosed i18n key and wired it into the status guard
lib/schemas/answer.ts questionId field had .min(1) but no upper bound, unlike the capped text/value fields — added .max(100) for DoS-hygiene consistency

TOCTOU: updateMany's WHERE clause only guarded on mode IS NULL, not re-checking status, leaving a narrow window where a mode could be set on a cycle that became non-collecting between the initial read and the write — added status: "collecting" to the updateMany WHERE clause
deferredTitles: No rate limiting on chooseMode or any /respond/* server action — general recommendation for an edge/middleware rate limit, not specific to this slice, tracked alongside existing SEC-BL-01 auth rate-limit backlog item
